scope: Formal pre-runtime comparison of two recognition-memory generative candidate families at the raw response and SDT-summary levels; no active model selection, Pencode, runtime or UI.

primary_candidates.label: Equal-variance continuous signal-detection recognition model
primary_candidates.what_memory_parameter_is_not: The parameter d is not Pencode, a probability, direct attention, neural encoding strength or recollection probability.
primary_candidates.known_boundary: The equal-variance assumption is a transparent reference simplification; recognition-memory evidence often supports unequal target and foil variances.

primary_candidates.label: Symmetric two-high-threshold recognition model with guessing
primary_candidates.what_memory_parameter_is_not: The parameter Ddet is a model-specific detection-state probability and is not automatically an item-level Pencode.
primary_candidates.known_boundary: The symmetric detection assumption is a deliberate two-parameter comparator. A general asymmetric 2HT model introduces separate target and foil detection parameters and is underidentified from one H,F point.

one_point_identifiability.reason: For any nondegenerate operating point with 0 < F < H < 1, EVSD can recover d and c, while the symmetric 2HT comparator can recover Ddet and g and reproduce the same H and F.
one_point_identifiability.published_mean_dprime_reason: A mean d-prime does not uniquely determine raw hit and false-alarm rates and cannot discriminate the candidate families.

asymmetric_2ht_boundary.reason: Three latent parameters cannot be identified from two response probabilities without additional constraints or data.

candidate_invariance.EVSD: d remains invariant while c changes
candidate_invariance.2HT: Ddet remains invariant while g changes

roc_predictions.EVSD: curved ROC in probability coordinates under continuous Gaussian evidence
roc_predictions.2HT: linear ROC in the basic threshold model when guessing/bias varies and detection remains fixed
roc_predictions.boundary: ROC shape is candidate-specific evidence under model assumptions, not a universal theorem; the recognition-memory literature contains an active historical debate.

initial_parameterization.EVSD: one d per Hsimp condition plus criterion parameters for response settings
initial_parameterization.2HT: one Ddet per Hsimp condition plus guessing parameters for response settings

sources.citation: Shulman, H. C., Markowitz, D. M., & Rogers, T. (2024). Reading dies in complexity: Online news consumers prefer simple writing. Science Advances, 10(23), eadn2555.
Wixted, J. T. (2007). Dual-process theory and signal-detection theory of recognition memory. Psychological Review, 114(1), 152-176.
Bröder, A., Kellen, D., Schütz, J., & Rohrmeier, C. (2013). Validating a two-high-threshold measurement model for confidence rating data in recognition. Memory, 21(8), 916-944.
Dube, C., & Rotello, C. M. (2012). Binary ROCs in perception and recognition memory are curved. Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition, 38(1), 130-151.

Pazzaglia, A. M., Dube, C., & Rotello, C. M. (2013). A critical comparison of discrete-state and continuous models of recognition memory: implications for recognition and beyond. Psychological Bulletin, 139(6), 1173-1203.

Spanton, R. W., & Berry, C. J. (2020). The unequal variance signal-detection model of recognition memory: Investigating the encoding variability hypothesis. Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology, 73(8), 1242-1260.

planned_patterns.name: One-point equifinality
planned_patterns.pattern: At a registered nondegenerate synthetic H,F operating point, both primary candidates must reconstruct the same H and F within numerical tolerance.

planned_patterns.name: EVSD inverse consistency
planned_patterns.pattern: The EVSD inverse mapping H,F to d,c followed by its forward mapping must reproduce the original operating point.

planned_patterns.name: Symmetric 2HT inverse consistency
planned_patterns.pattern: For valid H >= F, the symmetric 2HT inverse mapping H,F to Ddet,g followed by its forward mapping must reproduce the original operating point.

planned_patterns.name: Pencode remains absent
planned_patterns.pattern: Neither EVSD d nor 2HT Ddet may be represented as Pencode.

planned_patterns.name: One operating point does not select model family
planned_patterns.pattern: A single H,F point or a single mean Drecog must not be represented as identifying EVSD versus 2HT.

planned_patterns.name: Bias manipulation preserves candidate memory parameter
planned_patterns.pattern: Under a synthetic pure-bias manipulation, EVSD must vary c with d fixed and 2HT must vary g with Ddet fixed.

planned_patterns.name: Raw-response fitting required
planned_patterns.pattern: Future candidate fitting must use raw/binomial recognition response data when available and may not fit only the published condition mean Drecog.

planned_patterns.name: ROC prediction assumptions explicit
planned_patterns.pattern: Candidate-specific ROC curvature or linearity expectations must retain their model assumptions and may not be stated as universal recognition-memory facts.
